data.description:
# Manually test the story-line extraction (core + Main Street)

**Goal:** As a developer/QA, manually exercise the extracted generic story-line system and confirm the mechanic behaves exactly as before, that the Gym demo works, and that the documentation matches observable behaviour.

## Context

The branching story-line mechanic was extracted from `tce-main-street` into the generic, game-agnostic `@story-line` module in this repo (see work item `CG-0MVH2H67H002M27B`). Main Street now consumes it through thin adapters. This item is the **manual acceptance pass** that complements the automated parity/full-suite gates.

- Core module: `src/story-line/` (alias `@story-line`).
- Gym demo: `example-games/gym/scenes/GymStorylineScene.ts`.
- Core reference: `docs/core-engine/story-line.md`.
- Consumer: `tce-main-street` at `dev` 87486479 (core submodule `fab1ce28`).

## Acceptance criteria

- **Gym demo walkthrough.** Run `npm install && npm run dev`, open the Gym, select **Storyline**, and verify:
  - the Town Meeting card presents **Invest** / **Ignore** with the default UI adapter's choice-clarity labels;
  - **Invest** applies +120 coins and deals **Public Investment**, which offers **Celebrate** / **Double down**;
  - **Celebrate** deals the terminal **New Beginning** card, applies +60 reputation and ends the chain ("Chain complete");
  - a terminal option (**Double down** / **Let it be**) ends the chain immediately with no successor;
  - **Reset** restarts the demo from Town Meeting; the journal/status panel tracks the choices.
- **Main Street shipped storylines.** In `tce-main-street`, play each of the five shipped arcs (tax, health, economy, labour, restaurant) and verify manually:
  - the dialog title is the storyline name and the subtitle is the incident name;
  - the option labels and choice-clarity labels match the documented semantics (apply vs skip, no escalation card revealed);
  - choosing an option applies the expected coin/reputation effect and deals the documented successor (or ends the chain for terminal options);
  - the **Story update** activity-log line and the Storyline Journal entry match the chosen option;
  - undo/redo of a choice and a save/load round-trip preserve the pending/resolved choice and its option snapshot.
- **Determinism.** With the same game seed, replaying a storyline produces the same presented options and successor selection (one seeded draw per candidate selection).
- **No regression.** Non-storyline incidents still resolve as plain incidents (no choice dialog); terminal escalation cards carrying a `storylineId` do not become choices.
- **Docs match reality.** `docs/core-engine/story-line.md` (core) and `docs/game/storylines.md` (Main Street) accurately describe the adapters, the Gym demo and the manual steps above; report any drift as a follow-up.

## Suggested test data

- Shipped CSV: `tce-main-street/src/card-data.csv` (storyline ids `storyline-tax`, `storyline-health`, `storyline-economy`, `storyline-labor`, `storyline-restaurant`).
- Gym fixture: the in-scene cards in `GymStorylineScene.ts`.

## Out of scope

- Automated test coverage (already green: parity gate + both full suites).
- New storyline authoring / conditional options (tracked separately).

## Notes

- Record the exact steps taken, observed results, build/commit tested, and any screenshots or notes in a comment before closing.
- If a behaviour differs from the pre-extraction behaviour, file a bug and reference this item.
